name: Gallery
description: Images in a square grid or in masonry columns, with optional captions. A click shows the image large in a native popover (no script), opens the image file, or does nothing.

layout.description: grid: equal tiles. masonry: columns keeping each image's height. row: a scroll-snap strip (a focusable region). mosaic: the first tile spans 2×2.

columns.description: Images per row on wide screens; two on phones.

open.description: popover: the image opens large in place (Popover API; Escape or a click outside closes it). link: the thumbnail links to the image file (the WordPress 'link to media file'). none: images only.

aspect.description: Tile shape (a masonry keeps each image's own).

captionStyle.description: below: caption under the image. overlay: over the image foot on hover and keyboard focus, always shown below md.

hoverEffect.description: zoom: a slight scale on hover, only where reduced motion is not requested.

items.label: Images

imageAlt.label: Image description
imageAlt.description: What the image shows, for readers who cannot see it.

full.label: Full-size image
full.description: The original file the viewer shows large, where the source links to it; otherwise the image itself.

items.description: The images in order (core/gallery inner images, Elementor gallery items, Divi gallery_ids).

closeLabel.description: Text of the viewer's close button (ui-strings gallery.close).

id.description: Section id, unique per page: viewer ids derive from it (`<id>-image-<n>`).

enlargeLabel.description: Prefix of each thumbnail button's name for screen readers ("Enlarge: <description>").

regionLabel.description: Name of the scrolling row's region when the gallery has no heading.

measured.description: The source section's measured style (MeasuredStyle): frame width, padding, fill, image, columns per width, gap, text tone, radius, minimum height — all in pixels. Absent, the site's tokens; present, it wins over tone and columns. Values that are not a number, a colour or a known keyword are dropped.

color.description: Fill colour: hex, rgb(a) or hsl(a).

image.description: Background image address (http(s) or root-relative), drawn behind the content.

overlay.description: Colour or linear/radial gradient laid over the image or the fill.

size.description: cover, contain or auto; anything else draws as cover.

position.description: One or two of center/top/bottom/left/right or percentages.

columns.description: Item columns at 390 (base), 768 (md) and 1280 (lg) px; a missing width follows the narrower one.

tone.description: What the text is set for: dark = light text on a dark band. Without it, a fill's own lightness decides.

align.description: Where the heading and lead sit; read by a component whose own align is not set.

a11y: A list of figures. In popover mode each thumbnail is a <button> named by the image's alt (or caption) that opens the viewer; the viewer has a visible close button, and Escape closes it, returning focus to the thumbnail. Captions are <figcaption>s. A scrolling row is a labelled region with tabindex 0 so the keyboard can scroll it; thumbnail buttons are named "Enlarge: …". The viewer has no next/previous (it would need script).
